The '''Second Alsakan Conflict''' was one of the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], a series of wars that pitted the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] against the influential [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]. Beginning approximately [[16,200 BBY]], the Conflict saw fighting in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] with the [[Second Siege of Porus Vida]] around [[16,100 BBY]], and in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] with the [[Gizer Campaign]] about a [[16,000 BBY|century later]], while the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the war saw fighting in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], primarily during the [[Core Campaigns]] around [[15,600 BBY]]. The planets [[Skako/Legends|Skako]] and [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] were both attacked during this time,<ref name="Warfare" /> and [[Belgoth's Beacon]]&mdash;one of the original [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacons]] commissioned by [[Borte Belgoth]] around [[25,100 BBY]]&mdash;was destroyed during fighting along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The Republic planet [[Abhean/Legends|Abhean]] was the site of a battle known as the [[Strontium Raid]] in [[15,480 BBY]], though the Conflict ended in a draw in [[15,400 BBY]] like the rest of the wars.<ref name="Warfare" />
